en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small baroque-style church on a raised stone terrace with stairs leading up to a columned porch. The church has a steep tiled roof with small decorative gables and a clock tower with a spire. Leafless trees surround the building, and a child sits at the bottom of the steps. German captions are printed below the image and along the right edge.
